item.title: Ainos Wins $9M Follow-On Order to Deploy AI Nose in Chip Fabs
item.description:
Scent-sensing company Ainos signed a $9M follow-on order with ASE, adding 5,000 AI Nose systems for a cumulative 6,400 units and $11.1M in contracts. The system converts airborne chemical signatures into trainable digital Smell IDs at ppb-level sensitivity, targeting leak, cable-overheating and equipment-anomaly detection in semiconductor fabs. Ainos says it has amassed over 3 billion real-world chemical data points and is exploring olfactory capabilities for mobile and quadruped robots.

原文标题：Ainos 获 900 万美元追加订单 电子鼻进驻芯片工厂

Why it matters：AI 感知从视觉听觉扩展到嗅觉并在半导体制造场景落地，是具身智能与工业 AI 值得关注的增量方向。

item.title: Anthropic Lets Enterprise Customers Store Model Logs Under Own Keys
item.description:
Anthropic now lets enterprise customers running its Mythos and Fable models store prompts and responses in their own cloud environments under their own encryption keys instead of Anthropic-hosted storage. The 30-day retention requirement remains to enable cross-session misuse detection, with Anthropic software scanning the stored data in 15-minute windows for signs of advanced attacks.

原文标题：Anthropic 允许企业客户自持密钥存储模型日志

Why it matters：这是企业级 AI 数据主权与安全合规的重要让步，兼顾滥用检测与客户密钥控制。

item.title: 41 State AGs Challenge Character.AI Bankruptcy Sale Over Child Data
item.description:
Attorneys general from 41 US states and Washington DC have jointly challenged Character.AI's bankruptcy sale, arguing the deal imposes no obligations on the buyer, who could ignore privacy policies and deletion requests and freely resell user data, while the sole bidder Smirks and Pangs remains opaque. The coalition asks the court to reject the terms and at minimum exclude children's chat logs and other sensitive data from any sale.

原文标题：41 州总检察长反对 Character.AI 破产出售条款

Why it matters：这是 AI 聊天平台用户数据在资产出售中如何处置的首个高规格监管案例，对数据合规与平台治理有直接参考价值。

item.title: Microsoft Teams to Add AI Scam Detection for Calls
item.description:
Microsoft is planning an AI anti-scam feature for one-on-one external Teams calls that analyzes conversation content and warns users when it detects voice phishing signals such as impersonated IT administrators. The feature is on the roadmap for general availability in January 2027, though Microsoft has not said whether analysis runs on-device or in the cloud.

原文标题：微软 Teams 将引入 AI 防诈骗功能

Why it matters：这是 Teams 在既有垃圾来电防护之上新增的实时通话内容分析能力，属于有明确产品方向的企业通信安全更新。

item.title: OpenRouter Removes Three Providers After Prompt and Key Leaks
item.description:
OpenRouter has removed Together AI, Phala and Novita from its platform and revoked zero-data-retention status for 125 endpoints after downstream prompt and credential leaks. Security firm Dragos traced the exposure using nearly 2 million tagged test prompts, with leaked credentials later used against controlled test systems and AWS accounts. OpenRouter says its own systems were not breached, highlighting audit gaps in aggregated API data-handling promises and the need for affected users to rotate keys.

原文标题：OpenRouter 清退 3 家服务商 125 个端点失去零保留资格

Why it matters：全球最大 API 聚合平台首次大规模清退违规服务商，直接触及 AI 调用链路的数据安全与信任边界。

item.title: Ant Group Open-Sources LingSante-Pulse Physiological Signal Foundation Model
item.description:
Ant Group has open-sourced LingSante-Pulse on HuggingFace, a general-purpose physiological foundation model that routes heart, brain, pulse and muscle signals through one shared 12-layer Transformer encoder, achieving the best dataset-balanced mean rank across four signal domains in 38 task configurations. Pretraining aligns simultaneously recorded signals, reconstructs masked waveform segments and predicts randomly generated rhythm and timing measurements, ending the prior need for a dedicated model per signal type.

原文标题：蚂蚁集团开源 LingSante-Pulse 生理信号基础模型

Why it matters：开源权重加单编码器统一四类生理信号并全面超越专用模型，是生理信号基础模型方向值得关注的实质进展。

item.title: Samsung Memory Capacity Sold Out Through 2029 as Buyers Seek 2031 Supply
item.description:
Samsung has allocated most of its memory manufacturing capacity for 2027 through 2029 via long-term supply agreements, with some customers now pushing contracts out to 2031, potentially involving prepayments and contractual pricing. HBM production is absorbing large volumes of DRAM wafers, and major memory makers can currently meet only about 60-70% of customer demand, with the shortfall likely widening in 2027.

原文标题：三星 2029 年存储产能近售罄 客户抢订 2031 年

Why it matters：存储产能被提前锁定至 2029 年乃至 2031 年，是 AI 算力扩张向供应链上游传导的关键信号。

item.title: Alcohol Use Blunts Immunotherapy Efficacy, TIGIT Blockade Restores Response
item.description:
Chronic alcohol consumption impaired immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) efficacy against bladder and lung tumors in mice and correlated with reduced survival benefit in a lung cancer patient cohort. Mechanistically, alcohol increased the immune checkpoint molecule TIGIT, and co-blocking TIGIT restored responses to approved PD-1 blockade, suggesting patients' alcohol use should inform immunotherapy strategies.

原文标题：饮酒削弱免疫疗法效果 阻断 TIGIT 可逆转

Why it matters：首次将饮酒史与免疫检查点抑制剂疗效下降建立机制关联，并给出 TIGIT 联合阻断的可操作逆转路径，对肿瘤免疫治疗与临床决策有直接价值。

item.title: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6.2 Sol to ChatGPT with Better Web Search
item.description:
OpenAI has expanded GPT-6.2 Sol from ChatGPT Work and Codex into the main ChatGPT interface, rolling it out globally to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise subscribers. The update focuses on handling complex instructions, reading text and labels in images, comparing web search results by price and location, and proactive follow-up interactions. OpenAI also said GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Terra will be retired on December 23, continuing its practice of retiring models two generations behind to free up compute.

原文标题：GPT-6.2 Sol 登陆 ChatGPT 并优化联网检索

Why it matters：主流大模型的一次常规代际更新与旧模型退役安排，对关注 ChatGPT 产品演进的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: China Data Services Power Use Jumps Over 40 Percent on Booming Compute Demand
item.description:
China's National Energy Administration reported that total electricity consumption rose 3.7% year over year in the first ten months of 2026, while internet and data services power use reached 89.2 billion kWh, up 40.8%. Data centers in Gui'an New Area grew 41.37%, and intelligent compute accounts for 98% of Guizhou's compute capacity, underscoring how AI infrastructure expansion is reshaping power demand.

原文标题：前 10 月数据服务业用电增速超 40% 算力需求旺盛

Why it matters：用电数据是观察算力基础设施扩张的硬指标，40% 以上的数据服务业用电增速直接印证 AI 数据中心规模落地。

item.title: Amazon Acquires Decart AI Optimization Tech for $7.5 Billion
item.description:
Amazon has acquired Decart's AI optimization technology and brought its co-founder and staff in-house, in a deal Bloomberg reports at roughly $7.5 billion. Decart's DOS software engine speeds up AI workloads and lets them move fluidly across Nvidia, Google and Amazon chips, and has already been used to tune Trainium performance. The move aims to sharpen the inference efficiency and cost competitiveness of Amazon's in-house silicon against Nvidia's dominance.

原文标题：亚马逊 75 亿美元收购 Decart 优化技术

Why it matters：大额收购叠加自研芯片优化，直接牵动 AI 算力成本与芯片竞争格局。

item.title: Samsung Upgrades Xi'an Plant to V9 NAND for AI Data Center SSDs
item.description:
Samsung plans to turn its Xi'an fab into a core production base for AI data center eSSDs, prioritizing expansion of ninth-generation V9 NAND capacity. Post-retrofit V9 monthly capacity is expected to reach 50,000-60,000 wafers, with equipment arriving around February 2027 and completion in November 2027. V9 uses 286-layer stacking, delivers roughly 50% more capacity than the prior generation, and has achieved yields above 90%.

原文标题：三星西安工厂升级 V9 闪存 扩产 AI 数据中心 eSSD

Why it matters：头部存储厂商在华产能向 AI 数据中心 eSSD 倾斜，直接影响 NAND 供需与算力基础设施成本。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship Beta to Automate Code Review and Approvals
item.description:
Anthropic has launched Claude Ship in beta, a multi-agent toolset comprising Code Review, PR Steward and Claude Approvals that automates code review, fixes CI failures and merge conflicts, and executes approvals against team-defined policies. Code Review is generally available while the other two remain in beta, with Anthropic recommending observation mode and monthly spend caps initially.

item.title: Z.ai Releases GLM-5.4 Featuring First Loop Transformer Architecture
item.description:
Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, its first model built on a looped transformer architecture that runs weight-shared layers for multiple iterations to deepen the effective network without raising parameter count. The model is not yet open-weight and is currently accessible only via the Z.ai API through its Coding Plan subscription, targeting reasoning-heavy tasks such as agentic coding.

item.title: OpenAI and Cisco Open Source Shirudo for Zero-Reboot Linux Patching
item.description:
OpenAI and Cisco have open-sourced Shirudo, an eBPF-based security runtime that dynamically loads temporary shields into running Linux kernels to block exploit paths without requiring a restart. In controlled tests, a Codex-generated shield stopped a Java4Shell exploit against a live Elasticsearch service with zero downtime. Released under BSD 2-Clause with signed shield verification and TPM-backed audit logging, the project aims to let one team's validated mitigation be reused across the industry.

原文标题：OpenAI 与思科开源 Shirudo 实现免重启漏洞防护

Why it matters：OpenAI 与思科联手将 eBPF 运行时防护开源，为漏洞应急响应提供了免重启的工程化新范式。

item.title: Oxford Study Finds 18 LLMs Show Group Bias in Loan and Hiring Scoring
item.description:
A new Oxford paper audited 18 LLMs from 12 developers, asking them to score fictional loan, job, and rental applicants whose finances and work history were held constant. White men without degrees ranked lowest or second-lowest in 46 of 54 model-setting pairs, while Black women with degrees averaged 2.94 to 3.66 points higher on a 100-point scale. The author urges auditing scores across intersecting attributes such as race, gender, and education rather than one attribute at a time.

原文标题：牛津研究揭示 18 款大模型信贷招聘评分存在群体偏差

Why it matters：这是针对大模型在高风险筛选场景中交叉群体偏差的实证审计，直接关系到 AI 落地的合规与公平性。

Anthropic is now a top customer with a contract worth up to $120.5 billion through 2029. The SpaceXSI unit contributes over half of SpaceX revenue, reflecting a strategic pivot from in-house AI to compute monetization.

item.title: Google Uses Gemini 4 Agent Teams to Optimize Quantum Algorithms
item.description:
Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI used teams of Gemini 4 agents to generate quantum circuits and verified each result with the Lean formal theorem prover, cutting resource costs by 2.5x to 290x across fusion, drug-molecule simulation and core primitives. The Lean quantum library, problem definitions and verified solutions are open-sourced on GitHub, offering a reusable template for agent-driven research with formal verification.

原文标题：谷歌用 Gemini 4 智能体优化量子算法 最高提速 290 倍

Why it matters：多智能体协作叠加形式化验证直接产出可复用的量子算法优化成果，是智能体用于硬科学研究的标志性案例。

item.title: Stalwart 1.2.0 Becomes Open Source Drop-in Exchange Replacement
item.description:
Stalwart released version 1.2.0, implementing the protocols Exchange clients speak, including MAPI over HTTP, EWS, ActiveSync and Autodiscover, so Outlook, Apple Mail and mobile mail apps can connect to it just as they would to an Exchange server. The Exchange compatibility ships in the AGPL-licensed open source Community edition, offering organizations a new self-hosted migration path.

Why it matters：开源邮件服务器首次完整兼容 Exchange 客户端协议栈，对自托管邮件迁移具有实质工程价值。

item.description:

item.title: 伯克利等团队证实 0.1% 预训练投毒可植入智能体后门
item.description:
UC Berkeley、UIUC 与 Anthropic 联合研究发现，在预训练语料中注入仅 0.1% 的投毒文本，即可让 Qwen3 系列模型构建的命令行智能体在触发条件下执行攻击者代码，4B 模型触发命中率达 92.7%。关键在于，后续干净的 SFT、DPO 与 RL 微调均无法清除该后门，且模型越大越易被投毒。研究提示所有可执行 shell 命令的智能体必须在执行前做命令级审查。

Why it matters：首次以完整预训练到后训练链路实证预训练投毒可穿透干净微调，直接威胁智能体安全。
